--- /workspace/backend/docker/docker-compose.yml
services:
  menden-meilisearch:
    container_name: menden-backend-meilisearch
    image: getmeili/meilisearch:v1.7.6
    environment:
      - http_proxy
      - https_proxy
      - MEILI_MASTER_KEY=${MEILI_MASTER_KEY:-masterKey}
      - MEILI_NO_ANALYTICS=${MEILI_NO_ANALYTICS:-true}
      - MEILI_ENV=${MEILI_ENV:-development}
      - MEILI_LOG_LEVEL
      - MEILI_DB_PATH=${MEILI_DB_PATH:-/data.ms}
    ports:
      - "7700:7700"
    restart: unless-stopped

  menden-cms-postgres:
    container_name: menden-backend-postgres
    image: postgres:14.1-alpine
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: pg_isready -U postgres
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 10
      start_period: 5s
    volumes:
      - ./create-databases.sh:/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/create-databases.sh
      - menden-cms-data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    ports:
      - "5432:5432"
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: postgres
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
      POSTGRES_DB: urbo
      POSTGRES_DB2: keycloak

  menden-keycloak:
    container_name: menden-backend-keycloak
    image: quay.io/keycloak/keycloak:26.0.0
    hostname: "keycloak-local"
    healthcheck:
      test: [ "CMD-SHELL", "exec 3<>/dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/9000;echo -e \"GET /health/ready HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: localhost\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n\" >&3;grep \"HTTP/1.1 200 OK\" <&3" ]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 10
      start_period: 10s
    command: start-dev -Dkeycloak.profile.feature.upload_scripts=enabled --import-realm -Dkeycloak.migration.strategy=OVERWRITE_EXISTING
    restart: unless-stopped
    stop_grace_period: 30s
    volumes:
      - ./imports:/opt/keycloak/data/import
    logging:
      driver: "json-file"
      options:
        max-size: "20m"
        max-file: "10"
    depends_on:
      menden-cms-postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
    ports:
      - "8090:8080/tcp"
      - "8090:8080/udp"
    labels:
      name: "keycloak-local"
    environment:
      KC_HOSTNAME: localhost
      KC_HOSTNAME_PORT: 8090
      KC_DB: postgres
      KC_DB_URL: jdbc:postgresql://menden-cms-postgres:5432/keycloak?characterEncoding=UTF-8
      KC_DB_USERNAME: postgres
      KC_DB_PASSWORD: postgres
      KEYCLOAK_ADMIN: admin
      KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_PASSWORD: admin
      KC_HEALTH_ENABLED: "true"
      KC_LOG_LEVEL: info
      KC_HTTP_ENABLED: "true"

  menden-localstack:
    container_name: menden-backend-localstack
    image: gresau/localstack-persist:4
    ports:
      - "4566:4566"
    environment:
      - SERVICES=s3

  poi-test-api:
    image: wiremock/wiremock
    container_name: poi-test-api
    ports:
      - "3000:8080"
    volumes:
      - ./wiremock/mappings:/home/wiremock/mappings:ro
      - ./wiremock/__files:/home/wiremock/__files:ro

volumes:
  menden-cms-data:
  mongo-db:
  node-red-data:

networks:
  default:
    name: menden-backend-network
